Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. Question: Aslam alikum mufti sahib mere ek parashani hai ki mere ghar wala muja force karta hai bank naukri ka liya lakin mein nahi chahata hoon ki mein us mein naukri karou muja kuch wazwwfa degeya ki unke dil mein nafrat ho jaye 2. Mufti sahib muja kuch wazeefa bataye jise mein ziyarat kar paa woo. meharbana kar ka batdigaye aur mere liya dua ki jeya gaa Allah hum sab ko kamil imaan ata kara aur Hazrat Nabi s.a.w ki sunnat pe chalna ki tawfeeq ata kara aur ziyarat ata kara . Ameen. Answer ID: 24539 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1453/1131/B=1431) (1) Stand firm on your intention and recite Ya Aziz (يا عزيز) after Isha salah two hundred times with durood 3-3 times before and after, turning your face towards your house. Follow this for forty days. (2) For this, you should follow the sunnah and recite durood extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
